metadata.title: Clicked like a potato on espresso and somehow duped 1 unlucky soul? Valorant maths broke
metadata.description:
Just mashed the keyboard like it owed me money.
Enemy probably uninstalling or looking for a new game.
Did NOT deserve that but hey, the chaos picked me today.
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, join the club.
